data_center_financing.note: Material repricing: $18bn of Project Jupiter loans were quoted around 89-91 cents and broader syndication reportedly stalled. Treat as sector stress, not yet a system-wide freeze.

private_credit.note: Morgan Stanley North Haven PIF saw 11.4% redemption requests versus a 5% repurchase limit. Elevated liquidity pressure, though the backlog may be stabilizing.

bank_ai_inventory.note: Banks reportedly retained more Oracle-linked project debt than planned after distribution weakened. This overlaps with the data-center event, so v2 caps its portfolio weight.
